decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting rests on long certification and procurement investments and long defense project cycles, so management keeps it and attributes slow uptake to procurement timing.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and supports the ergonomic workplace positioning, so management still treats modest sales as a ramp-up rather than failure.
The publicly launched G2 generation of a core interior luminaire is central to the LED portfolio, and the investment and public commitment make withdrawal hard to justify.
As a flagship of the firm's announced direction, the microprismatic pendant carries the highest visible commitment, so any weakness would be attributed to temporary market conditions.

Despite the withdrawal of the related HMI searchlight, the remaining marine searchlight line consolidates the firm's marine offering, so management keeps it to justify its investment in the niche, though the risk is somewhat higher.
